rows.en:
{C:81902201}{C:819582969A2900000000}Nelfea,
what's this next continent called?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582969C2900000000}The Astragius continent.

{C:81902201}{C:819582969D2900000000}Oh, Chirico.
Astragius?
Could that be your...?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582969E2900000000}That's right...

{C:819582969F2900000000}(Fyana...)

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A12900000000}The Astante is
entering the Astragius continent.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296A22900000000}I entrusted you with FT units and let you act.
...I commend you for drawing
the continents into war.

{C:81958296A32900000000}But...
I must say that merely seizing Norstan
falls short of my expectations.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296A52900000000}I am sorry...

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296A72900000000}If you feel that way,
then sink the Astante.
By any means necessary.

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296A92900000000}Understood.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193CC00}{C:81958296AA2900000000}Ah, Astante, do you read me?

{C:8193CA00}{C:81958296AB2900000000}Hiii, everyone!
It's me, Coconna!
You remember me, right?!

{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296BE0000000000}No fair, Coconna!
Let me talk too!

{C:8193CC00}{C:81958296AC2900000000}Quit getting in the way, both of you!
Anyway, it's {C:819782830300}Kummen{C:819782830000} where
you'll find us.

{C:81958296AD2900000000}Now that you're back,
make sure you come see us!
That goes for you too, Duo!

{C:8193CF01}{C:81958296AE2900000000}Yeah, yeah, I know.

{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296BF0000000000}Then we'll be waitin' for you!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296AF2900000000}Oh! You're all back!
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm, you look well!

{C:81958296B02900000000}I knew you'd make fine VOTOMS riders.
I was right about you!

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296B22900000000}Boss!
You got it wrong again!

{C:81958296B42900000000}AT riders are called VOTOMS, right?
'VOTOMS riders' makes it sound like
'AT rider riders,' doesn't it?

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296B52900000000}Was that it?
Well, whatever you call it,
I'm just glad you're safe!

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C00000000000}We've got ourselves a place!
And the name is... ta-da!
{C:819782830300}Phantom Lady{C:819782830000}!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296B72900000000}...I don't like the name.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C10000000000}Chirico, baby!
We've had it rough!

{C:81958296C20000000000}We wanted to make a place
where you could rest when you came back.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296BA2900000000}Kummen's in a civil war, you know.
There were plenty of ways to make money.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BB2900000000}Thank you!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296BC2900000000}Himiko's first!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BD2900000000}Himikooo!
It's always something like this!
I'm getting so sick of it.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296BE2900000000}You're good at looking after others, Wataru.

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BF2900000000}Heh heh heh!
To put it plainly, you're absolutely right!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C02900000000}Oh, aren't you pleased with yourself.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296C12900000000}Since they've been so kind,
let us have a rest as well.
What say you, Wataru?

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296C22900000000}Yes, Teacher!
What should I eat?

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296C32900000000}Lilis, let's go too!

{C:81905400}{C:81958296C42900000000}Okaaay!
Amm, Leccee, come with us!

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C52900000000}I'm going to have them feed me
lots and lots of good stuff!

{C:81905700}{C:81958296C62900000000}You'll get fat.
Oh, you could stand to put on some weight.
Especially around the chest.

{C:81905600}{C:81958296C72900000000}I'm fine the way I am!
Unlike you, I'm still young!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C82900000000}My chest...

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C92900000000}What's wrong, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CB2900000000}N-Nothing at all.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CE2900000000}Really?
Then let's go too!

{C:8190CC00}{C:81958296CF2900000000}Let's have a proper celebration
to mark our reunion!
Eat and drink anything you like!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D02900000000}Huh?
Aren't you coming, Coconna?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296D12900000000}Mm... I've got
something to tell Chirico.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D32900000000}Me?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D42900000000}Then I'll go on ahead too.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296D52900000000}We haven't just been
sitting around here, you know.
We've been gathering information.

{C:81958296D62900000000}We've found out that Fyana
is somewhere in Kummen.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296D82900000000}Fyana's in {C:819782830300}Kummen{C:819782830000}?!
Where in Kummen?!
Tell me, Coconna!

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296D92900000000}Sorry, that's all
we've found out so far.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296DC2900000000}I see.
Sorry about that.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190A202}{C:81958296F42900000000}You're back.
We were discussing what to do next.

{C:81902201}{C:81958296F52900000000}Apparently, we can't go any farther
into the Cloud Sea.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F62900000000}Is that right, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F72900000000}It's hopeless.

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296F82900000000}So I was asking them
to hear my request.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F92900000000}What do you want us to do?

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296FA2900000000}Kummen's civil war will end once
{C:819782830400}Heloram Kanjelman III{C:819782830000} is
defeated.

{C:81958296FB2900000000}His Highness should be above this continent.
I want you to find him and defeat him.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296C50000000000}We were saying that, if we did that,
we might also find Fyana,
the woman Chirico's looking for.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296FC2900000000}We went ahead and discussed it without you,
but can we have your approval?
Rie's already given us permission.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FD2900000000}I don't have
any reason to object.
Let's do it!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296C60000000000}Workin' hard, Chirico, baby?

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296FF2900000000}Vanilla? What is it?

{C:8193CA00}{C:81958296002A00000000}I'm here too.

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296032A00000000}So, what do you two want?

{C:8193CB00}{C:81958296C70000000000}Well, see...
You tell him, Coconna.

{C:8193CA00}{C:81958296042A00000000}Huh? Me?
You tell him, Vanilla!

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296062A00000000}I'm busy.
Would you leave me alone?


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C80000000000}Ah, fine, I'll get right to it.
Why don't you stop looking
for the Phantom Lady?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296082A00000000}What?!

{C:8190CA00}{C:819582960C2A00000000}Please don't get angry.
We can't bear to see
you looking so miserable.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296C90000000000}We don't know what happened,
but we can't think of any reason
except the Phantom Lady.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582960E2A00000000}I see... I'm sorry.
But I appreciate your concern.
Thank you.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296CA0000000000}Huh?
What did Chirico just say?

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296102A00000000}He said thank you.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296CB0000000000}Chirico said thank you!
Now that's somethin' else!

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296122A00000000}If I've changed,
it's thanks to my companions.
They're the ones who changed me.

{C:8190CA00}{C:81958296142A00000000}In that case,
forget what we just said.

{C:8190CB00}{C:81958296CC0000000000}Yeah, that's right.
If you've found more good friends,
we've got nothin' more to say.



{x00}

{C:8193A602}{C:819582961E2A00000000}Wataru's being held
on that ship, right?

{C:8193F200}{C:819582961F2A00000000}So it would seem.
That's what Arago's
subordinates said.

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296202A00000000}All right! I'll beat them!

{C:8193F200}{C:81958296212A00000000}(Will this really work?
 Using a kid with that look in his eyes,
 like he's been brainwashed...?)




{x00}

{C:81939200}{C:81958296172A00000000}Jerid,
are you really going to attack?

{C:81938F00}{C:81958296182A00000000}Of course.
Why else would we have come
all the way out here?

{C:81939200}{C:81958296192A00000000}(It's dangerous to get so obsessed...)

{C:81939200}{C:819582961A2A00000000}We're pulling back, Jerid.

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961B2A00000000}Not yet! I can still fight!

{C:81939200}{C:819582961C2A00000000}Think about what this battle means!
You saw it too!
Are you just going to do as you're told?!

{C:81938F00}{C:819582961D2A00000000}All right... I'll retreat.



{x00}

{C:8193A502}{C:81958296B02A00000000}Toraoh, what's wrong?!
We're all right!

{C:8193A602}{C:81958296B12A00000000}I'll take back Wataru

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296B62A00000000}Let's go, Himiko.

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296B72A00000000}Okaaay!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B82A00000000}Wataru, Himiko,
where are you off to in such a hurry?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296B92A00000000}We're going to look for Tora-chan!

Do you think Tora-chan's dead?

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296BC2A00000000}Don't talk nonsense!
There's no way Toraoh's dead!

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296BD2A00000000}But... but...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296BE2A00000000}I'm sorry, Wataru.

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296C12A00000000}Please don't...

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296CB2A00000000}Well, when I came to,
I was in a pile of rubble or something.

{C:81958296CC2A00000000}Then I looked up and saw Ryujinmaru,
so I came running!

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296CD2A00000000}Toraoh... Toraoh... Toraooooh!

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296CE2A00000000}What's with you, Wataru?
Are you that happy
to see me?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296CF2A00000000}Tora-chan, come
with us!

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296D02A00000000}I've got nothing else to do anyway.
And you and Wataru are here,
so why not?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296D12A00000000}That's okay, right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D22A00000000}Yeah, of course.

{C:8193C800}{C:81958296232A00000000}This is Chirico.
Epsilon, release Fyana.

{C:8193D400}{C:81958296252A00000000}Why do you call her Fyana?
Because of that, she...
Chirico, if only you weren't here!

{C:81958296262A00000000}Face me, Chirico!
I'll end it all here!

{C:8193D300}{C:819582962A2A00000000}Pota...

rows.en:
{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296CA0100000000}Your Highness, why start a civil war...?

{C:8193D300}{C:819582962E2A00000000}Under the influence of other continents,
Kummen has changed far too quickly.

{C:819582962F2A00000000}As a result, nostalgia for the old ways
has become immeasurably strong.
I am nostalgia itself.

{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296CB0100000000}Your Highness, you can't mean...!

{C:8193D300}{C:81958296302A00000000}For Kummen's future, it would be better
if I, a member of the royal family, did not exist.
But... not while things stand as they are.

{C:81958296322A00000000}Drive out Grados, and with those people,
defeat whoever stands behind them.
You will do this for me, Pota?

{C:8193CF00}{C:81958296CC0100000000}I promise you, Your Highness.

{C:8193D300}{C:81958296342A00000000}Pota...
I... loved you...


{x00}

be here ahead of us.

{C:819582963A2A00000000}Oh, there he is!
Chirico!
How did it go?

{C:8190C800}{C:819582963B2A00000000}She's nowhere to be found...

{C:81904202}{C:819582963C2A00000000}According to Vanilla,
some strange man came and abducted her.

{C:81930100}{C:819582963D2A00000000}Abducted her?

{C:8190CE01}{C:819582963E2A00000000}He's apparently a soldier on Balarant's side.
We'll just have to look again.

{C:81930100}{C:819582963F2A00000000}Chirico, let's go.
If she's not in Kummen, let's search {C:819782830300}Uoodo{C:819782830000} and 
{C:819782830300}Gilgamesh{C:819782830000} for her.

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296402A00000000}Yeah. Thanks.




{x00}

{C:81958296422A00000000}Though I doubt you can move as you please
inside that machine!

{C:8193C900}{C:81958296432A00000000}Chirico...

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296572A00000000}Don't let it get you down.
With such a reckless move,
there was nothing we could do.

{C:81958296582A00000000}Instead, let's be grateful
that everyone is safe.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296592A00000000}Yeah.
You're right, Lun.
Thank you, Lun!

{C:819582965A2A00000000}I'll go see the others
and discuss what we do next.

{C:81900200}{C:819582965B2A00000000}All right. Good luck!

{C:81900300}{C:819582965C2A00000000}That's our Lun!
You really understand
what my big brother's like!

{C:81900200}{C:819582965F2A00000000}Do I?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296602A00000000}Now I see why he was so desperate
to get you back,
Lun!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296612A00000000}He was desperate?
Him?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296622A00000000}He thought
he was hiding it,
but it shows on his face so easily.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296632A00000000}It was obvious, wasn't it?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296642A00000000}Exactly!
He'd suddenly get all serious.

{C:81909500}{C:81958296652A00000000}You look like you're having fun.
May I join you?

{C:81900200}{C:81958296672A00000000}Of course.



{x00}

{C:81932F01}{C:819582966D2A00000000}Understood!

{C:81932D01}{C:819582966E2A00000000}And where are you going, Lord {C:819782830400}Le Caine{C:819782830000}?

{C:81932B01}{C:819582966F2A00000000}I am heading to another continent.

Let's do whatever the hell we want!

{C:81932C01}{C:81958296722A00000000}That sounds good.
I'm gonna have myself plenty of fun!

{C:81932F01}{C:81958296732A00000000}You, {C:819782830400}Gosterro{C:819782830000}!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296752A00000000}Damn it!
We can't do a thing at a time like this!

{C:81905300}{C:81958296762A00000000}Gotho,
can't you find us a ship somehow?

{C:81958296772A00000000}I left my ship
back in Pentagona,
so there's nothing I can do.

{C:8190C800}{C:819582967A2A00000000}Fyana, do you know anything?

{C:8190C900}{C:819582967B2A00000000}I'm sorry.
I don't know much about this area...

{C:8190CF00}{C:81958296CD0100000000}I don't remember hearing
about any ships in Kummen.

{C:8190A202}{C:819582967C2A00000000}We've got nothing to lose.
Why don't we split up
and search all over Kummen?

{C:81900A01}{C:819582967D2A00000000}Let's do that!
I don't know anything about ships,
but I can help look for one.

{C:81900300}{C:819582967E2A00000000}Everyone's offering to help,
so let's try looking, big brother.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2A00000000}All right!
Let's split up and search!




{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296882A00000000}Uncle!


{C:81930700}{C:81958296892A00000000}Stop calling me that.

{C:81930400}{C:819582968A2A00000000}Look, it's Uncle and the others!

{C:81930600}{C:819582968B2A00000000}Nelfea?

{C:81930300}{C:819582968C2A00000000}Dad, it's Rie.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296902A00000000}We're nearly finished loading
the machines from the other continents too.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296912A00000000}Dad...

{C:81900600}{C:81958296922A00000000}What is it?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296932A00000000}I'm sorry... I...

{C:81900600}{C:81958296942A00000000}You did well.
I don't mean getting Lun back.
You did well to gather allies from other continents.

{C:81958296952A00000000}Now we know who's pulling the strings,
they'll be an important source of strength.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296962A00000000}{C:819782830400}Redros Binzvanker{C:819782830000}
is the one who started
this war, apparently.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296972A00000000}Isn't Redros a war hero just like
you and the others, Dad?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296982A00000000}And Redros is also the one
who later set off the civil war.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296992A00000000}But I thought Redros was dead?

{C:81900A00}{C:819582969A2A00000000}Turns out Redros was still alive.
Stubborn bastard.

{C:81900600}{C:819582969B2A00000000}That enemy is strong.
We'll help you in the battles ahead.
Stay on your guard.


{x00}

{C:81900C00}{C:819582962A3700000000}Of course.

{C:81900600}{C:819582962B3700000000}Do you understand

{C:81930100}{C:819582962D3700000000}Dad!

{C:81900600}{C:819582962E3700000000}You... What are you doing here?

{C:81930100}{C:819582962F3700000000}I wanted a word with that one.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296303700000000}I have nothing to say to you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296313700000000}Well, I have something to say.

{C:81958296323700000000}...Thank you for not killing
Lun.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296333700000000}Heh... Ha ha ha ha!
How absurd!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296343700000000}Say whatever you like.
That was all I wanted to say.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296353700000000}What a sorry state of affairs.
The son of a hero, acting like this.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296363700000000}Yes, this boy's an idiot.
But I can't help loving
this idiot son of mine.

{C:81900C00}{C:81958296373700000000}Hmph...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296383700000000}Sorry to interrupt, Dad.


{C:81930600}{C:81958296393700000000}Oh, it's fine.
